name: Ambushers
description: An ambush is set by the PCs to catch unsuspecting adversaries off-guard.
impulses: Escape, group up, protect the most vulnerable

features.name: Relative Strength
features.description: The Difficulty of this environment equals that of the adversary with the highest Difficulty.
features.questions: Which adversary is the least prepared? Which one is the most?

features.name: Where Did They Come From?
features.description: When a PC starts the ambush on unsuspecting adversaries, you lose 2 Fear and the first attack roll a PC makes has advantage.
features.questions: What are the adversaries in the middle of doing when the ambush starts? How does this impact their approach to the fight?
